instruction: Look at task-019_initial.scad. Keep the provided step, text(), and groove construction, set label_height=0.8 and groove_depth=1, and do not replace the labels with generic raised geometry. Change the model into a three-level step calibration block centered at x=0 and y=0, with the front face at y=-10 mm. Level 1 is 40 x 20 x 5 mm (z=0 to 5 mm). Level 2 is 30 x 20 x 5 mm, centered on level 1 (z=5 to 10 mm). Level 3 is 20 x 20 x 5 mm, centered on level 2 (z=10 to 15 mm). The block height before text must be 15 mm. Add three raised labels with text(), using font="Liberation Sans:style=Regular", halign="center", valign="center", no rotation, and exactly 0.8 mm extrusion along +Z. When viewed from +Z, each label baseline must run along +X and the tops of the characters must point toward +Y. Place "5" at center (17.5, 0, 5) mm with size=3.2 mm, entirely on the exposed level-1 ledge x=15 to 20 mm; place "10" at center (12.5, 0, 10) mm with size=2.6 mm, entirely on the exposed level-2 ledge x=10 to 15 mm; and place "15" at center (0, 0, 15) mm with size=4 mm, entirely on the top surface x=-10 to 10 mm. Keep all three labels within y=-10 to 10 mm. Cut one rectangular reference groove into the front face of each level. Every groove must be 14 mm long along X, 1 mm high along Z, and exactly 1 mm deep along +Y from the front face: x=-7 to 7 mm and y=-10 to -9 mm. Use z=2 to 3 mm for the lower groove, z=7 to 8 mm for the middle groove, and z=12 to 13 mm for the upper groove. Save the completed source back to /home/user/Desktop/task-019_initial.scad, then fully render and export /home/user/Desktop/task-019_output.stl.
